themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with tools, and collaborate to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries and extract key insights.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Details the use of AI to aid developers in writing, debugging, reviewing, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to automate or enhance the process of testing product usability and functionality.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights specific AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates the effects of AI on job roles, skills, hiring, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to create new content, including text, images, video, and other media.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in understanding user needs, market trends, and informing product development decisions.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the research and development surrounding conversational AI agents, their capabilities, and user interactions.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data that simulate human users for testing and research.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
